summary_en: Onamba executed acquisition of up to 2.0 million shares (16.4% of outstanding shares) at a fixed price of 1,642 yen per share via ToSTNeT-3 on November 9, 2026, totaling up to 3.284 billion yen. Acquired shares will be retired early. Lead shareholder ESG Investment Partnership agreed to tender its holdings.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock through Off-Exchange Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
Onamba executed a block acquisition of treasury stock on November 9, 2026 via ToSTNeT-3, purchasing up to 2.0 million shares (16.4% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) at a fixed price of 1,642 yen per share. The total acquisition was capped at 3.284 billion yen.

The execution price matched the closing price (including final special quotations) on November 6, 2026. The buy order was placed for the trading session on November 9, 2026 at 8:45 a.m. Tokyo time and was limited to that session only. All acquired treasury shares are scheduled to be retired early.

This acquisition implements the company's medium-term business plan PROGRESS 2026, which targets achieving dividend payout ratio of 30% or higher by fiscal 2026 and enhanced shareholder returns through capital-efficient management and ROE improvement. The company's lead shareholder, ESG Investment Partnership, agreed to tender its holdings in support of this shareholder return initiative. As of November 6, 2026, the company held 371,611 treasury shares against 12,186,640 outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock).
